note: Comparison against free-form / no-governance multi-agent baselines under identical model (gpt-5.5), tools, and per-agent budgets. AutoGen free-form = agents freely exchange messages; ChatDev = SOP pipeline with LLM-driven internal chat; MetaGPT = SOP roles + free intra-role messaging. Adaptation rounds = 4 rounds of author prompt/topology tuning; OpenAgency uses 4 rounds of protocol evolution. Numbers are the primary metric of each benchmark.
reproducibility_note: Reproducibility std is the standard deviation of the primary metric across 3 independent seeds on SWE-bench.

handoff_rejection.note: Percentage of proposed handoff events rejected by Γ(n, s; P) during v4 runs; and percentage of runs where the rejection actually recovered a failure by forcing the agent to pick an admissible target.
